intro: Restocking the Larders is a provisioning quest in the Shen'dar Highlands of Zephras. With escalating wilderness threats keeping villagers from foraging, an adventurer is enlisted to gather eggs and strider meat to sustain the settlement.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Up for a bit of work? I could use a bit of muscle from a strong adventuring-type such as yourself. With how dangerous things are getting around here, no one's had much time to hunt or forage of late, and I need someone to get out there and source me fresh eggs and strider meat to keep this village fed.
I'd be happy to teach you one of my famous recipes if you can bring me what I need. What do you say?

clips.title: Progress
paras: No matter how much things change here on Zephras and how uncertain things get, I always say that a pipe full of dried peacebloom and nice full belly is a comfort that can't be beat!

clips.title: Completion
paras: These eggs aren't easy to get but wind save me, they are DELICIOUS fried up in a bit of ursera tallow.
If you've got a bit of time to spare and you enjoy cooking, I can teach you a few tips and tricks I've picked up. Say the word and I'd be happy to train you.

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
